title: Unmapped Ocean Floor Covers More Area Than Mars
hook: Earth's largest missing map sits beneath the ocean, not in space.
closing: Modern maps still leave a planet-sized blind spot across Earth's ocean floor.
question: Would you map ocean or Mars?

segments.say: Modern maps cover 28.7% of the ocean floor in 2026. Most seafloor still lacks detailed mapping.
Mars is 99.5% mapped. Its surface coverage far exceeds the ocean floor's.
Unmapped ocean floor spans 257 million square kilometers. That exceeds the entire surface area of Mars.
